collection.comment: A resident's own dossier. Read through the portal scoped by owner, never by an employee

collection.title: Dossier
collection.summary: Publications and documents a resident keeps together
collection.description: A resident's private dossier of Woo publications (hydra woo-citizen-journey, contract C1). The owner is the portal subject reference, set by the server. Only the owner reads it through the portal, and anyone reads it through a share link while the link exists, then only its public items.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name the resident gave the dossier.

description.title: Description
description.description: A note on the whole dossier.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The portal subject reference of the resident. Set by the server, never by the client. Never a BSN.

items.title: Items
items.description: The publications and documents in the dossier. Another app may append an item, never change or remove one.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication this item points at.

attachment.title: Document
attachment.description: The file id of one document of the publication, or null for the whole publication.

addedBy.title: Added by
addedBy.description: resident, or the app id that added it, for example dossiq.

title.title: Title
title.description: The publication title when the item was added, kept for when it is no longer public.

share.title: Share link
share.description: Set while a read-only link exists. Revoking sets it to null (an optional property accepts null).

token.title: Token
token.description: The collection id, a dot and 192 random bits in hex.

sourceOf.title: Started from this dossier
sourceOf.description: Case and ticket references started from this dossier.
